axis_roles.description: One role per input dimension, outermost first. 'spatial' and 'smooth' dimensions are predicted across (only 'spatial' ones enter the Jacobian); 'independent' dimensions and the 'component' dimension are coded index by index.

error_bound.description: Absolute error bound for interior samples, in the units of the stored values.

face_error_bound.description: Absolute error bound for samples on a chunk face (index 0 or N-1 along any predicted dimension). Must not exceed error_bound. Default error_bound / 4.

boundary.description: 'extrapolate' exists for comparison experiments only and is not seam-free.

grid_spacing.description: Distance between adjacent field samples along each 'spatial' dimension, in order, in the units of the stored values.

tight_error_bound.description: Error bound for samples promoted by the Jacobian check. Default error_bound / 8.
